world_change: ±0.72 ramp along training-set PC1; audit coordinate hidden from training
channel_drift: channel 6 post-measurement gain/offset/nonlinearity ramp; held-out test drift shape differs from training
state_input: each channel pre-core feature deviation from cross-channel consensus
optimization_target: six-channel reconstruction plus small state magnitude/smoothness penalty; no drift/world labels and no latent alignment loss
